Title: CINDER R1 Electric Grill Brush
Body (HTML):
A cordless motor spins a stainless head against the grate so you don't have to lean on it. The head comes off with the wrench in the box, so you can look at the wire before you cook.

  • Rolling stainless wire head, replaceable
  • Built-in steel scraper plate
  • 2000 mAh lithium-ion, USB-C charging
  • In the box: brush, head, USB-C cable, gloves, wrench

Never use on a hot grill.
